name: sshi_fbr
rationale: Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) is used to flip the voltage across the piezo capacitance at its extrema, which significantly increases the extracted energy. This should resolve the minimum voltage failures in S2 (heavy load) and S4 (weak excitation). A full-bridge rectifier (FBR) collects the energy, and a Zener diode (DZ33) is added to clamp the output voltage and prevent overvoltage in S3.
